Fig. 4 Mean squared error in the fixed-K sensitivity analysis based on 500 replicates per sample size. Clustering + IPW and Global PS + Cluster Label were evaluated with K = 2 and K = 4, while the true latent structure contained K = 3. Fig. 3 Distribution of Silhouette-Selected K Across 1,000 Latent-Cluster Simulations. Each panel shows, for a given sample size, how many replicates chose K ∈ {2, 3, 4, 5} as the silhouette-width “optimal” number of clusters. The true latent structure contained three clusters.
